div.div:
«boundary» (blue) — React components of packages/ui; their attributes are props
«control» (yellow) — client-side logic: the useDrive hook loads and re-renders, DriveViewModel holds the state, ApiClient talks to the server
«utility» (yellow) — fileList, a module of pure functions in packages/shared
«entity» / «enumeration» (green) — data carried between the layers (the enumerations are TypeScript union types)
